title: Hid Macro
briefDescription: A python based cli utility to record and replay user HID actions
fullDescription:
# HID Macro Recorder 🎥🖱️⌨️

Record and replay mouse and keyboard actions on Windows.

## 🔧 Features

- Start/stop recording with `F9/F10`
- Replay once with `F11`
- Loop random routines forever with `F12`
- Stop playback with `ESC`
- Delete last recorded routine with `F6`
- Clear memory routine with `F8`
- Exit with `F7`

## 🚀 Installation

```bash
pip install hid-macro
```

## ⌨️ Hotkeys

| Key     | Action                      |
|--------|-----------------------------|
| F9     | Start recording             |
| F10    | Stop recording & save       |
| F11    | Replay first routine        |
| F12    | Loop through random routines|
| F6     | Delete last saved routine   |
| F8     | Clear current memory routine|
| F7     | Quit                        |
| ESC    | Stop replay                 |

## 📦 Usage

After install, launch it with:
```bash
hid-macro
```
Or run from source:
```bash
python -m hid_macro.main
```

## 📁 Routines
All routines are saved as .json files in the routines/ folder relative to the installed package.

## 🛠 Dependencies
pyautogui

pynput

---
 
Made with ❤️ for power users and tinkerers.
